title: Listen and Choose a Response — Family

questions.stem: My sister just told me she's getting married next spring.

options.A: I think spring is my favorite season.
options.B: He got married two years ago.
options.C: That's wonderful! Have they picked a place yet?
options.D: I'll tell her you said that.

questions.explanation: Congratulating and asking a follow-up question fits happy news. The others focus on 'spring', switch pronoun and tense, or don't respond to the news.
questions.speaker: f3
